description: This file defines a template class TlsEnabled for managing TLS configuration in WebSocket connections, including setting certificate files, initializing SSL contexts, and handling verification. It includes methods for setting up TLS, loading certificates, and managing connection states.

classes.name: TlsEnabled
classes.description: A template class providing TLS setup and management for WebSocket connections, including SSL context initialization, certificate loading, and connection authentication.

methods.name: TlsEnabled
methods.description: Constructor that logs creation of TLS enabled websocket.

methods.name: setCertFileName
methods.description: Sets the certificate file name used for TLS.

methods.name: setKeyFileName
methods.description: Sets the private key file name used for TLS.

methods.name: setCAFileNames
methods.description: Sets the list of CA certificate file paths.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes TLS handler for the derived class's endpoint.

methods.name: setAuthenticationState
methods.description: Determines and sets the authentication success based on connection error codes.

methods.name: onTlsInit
methods.description: Creates and configures a new SSL context for TLS, loading certificates and setting options.

methods.name: loadCertificateAuthorities
methods.description: Loads CA certificates into the SSL context from specified file paths or defaults.
